subject: Re: Skyward Insurance — SIG ingestion and automated evidence proposal
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@skywardinsurance.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@skywardinsurance.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Skyward RFI — automated evidence ingestion and SIG mapping

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We received your SIG and a handful of attachments, but our security team prefers an automated evidence ingestion option if available — we have a large questionnaire and would like to avoid manual uploads.

Two asks to start: 1) can Redwood push control-level evidence into our evidence portal (S3-backed) via an API or temporary share, and 2) can you provide a control mapping CSV that maps Redwood SOC 2 controls to our SIG rows? If you have a sample payload/spec we can run a test ingest this week.

Attached: Skyward_SIG_v1.xlsx (partial).

Best,
Elena Martinez
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Skyward Insurance

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@skywardinsurance.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Skyward RFI — automated evidence ingestion and SIG mapping

Elena — thanks for the note and the clear ask. We can support an automated evidence ingestion flow and a control crosswalk. High level: 

- We have an Evidence Ingest API that accepts zip bundles with a JSON manifest (control_id -> evidence pointers).
- For SIG crosswalks we can generate a CSV mapping from our SOC 2 control ids + assertions to SIG rows; we typically include a confidence column and suggested sample artifacts.
- We can do a short test: Redwood will push a sample bundle to a pre-signed S3 bucket you provide, and then we will confirm the portal indexes the evidence and tags the associated SIG rows.

I'll attach a first-pass control mapping (control_mapping_v1.csv) and our Evidence API spec (evidence_api_spec.pdf). Priyom — can you confirm the maximum bundle size and encryption requirements? Karthik — can you confirm whether we should include token redaction in the sample artifacts?

Next steps we propose:
1) Skyward confirms S3 write location and encryption params by EOD Wed 11/11.
2) Redwood sends sample bundle and mapping on Thu 11/12 for your intake test.
3) Joint validation call Fri 11/13 (30 mins).

If that timeline doesn't work, tell us a preferred window.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Assurance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: control_mapping_v1.csv; evidence_api_spec.pdf
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@skywardinsurance.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Skyward RFI — automated evidence ingestion and SIG mapping

Elena / team — quick technical clarifications: 

- Bundle size: our ingest endpoint supports up to 2GB per bundle; for larger archives we can handshake a chunked upload with the pre-signed bucket.
- Encryption: we will push using AWS S3 server-side encryption (SSE-KMS). If Skyward requires client-side encryption/HSM wrapping, we support that via an artifact-encryption wrapper (we'll need the public key).
- Filenames and metadata: please ask the portal team to include an expected metadata schema (control_id, artifact_type, created_at). Our manifest generator uses those keys by default.

I'll prepare a small sample bundle (5 artifacts) and include a manifest that maps to the rows in the control_mapping_v1.csv.

— Priyom
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@skywardinsurance.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Skyward RFI — automated evidence ingestion and SIG mapping

Couple of notes from a controls perspective: 

- Our SOC 2 control ids line up to common SIG sections but we flag a few controls as partial coverage due to tenant-level telemetry retention differences — I'll annotate those in the CSV with a "coverage_note" column.
- For any controls where we return aggregated telemetry (rather than per-tenant raw logs), we will attach a mapping doc explaining where samples come from and how to interpret them.
- If Skyward's portal expects an exact SIG row id match, we can include both our control id and the SIG row in the manifest to support auto-tagging.

I'll add the coverage_note and example artifact descriptions by EOD Tue.

Karthik
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@skywardinsurance.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Skyward RFI — automated evidence ingestion and SIG mapping

Thanks everyone — the plan looks good. Procurement confirmed S3 details (pre-signed write token sent to Neha). A few clarifications from our intake team: 

- Please prefix artifact filenames with the SIG row id (e.g., SIG-3.1.2_redwood-config-audit.pdf).
- For partial-coverage controls, include a short "interpretation.txt" that explains why telemetry is aggregated and suggested alternative sampling methods.
- Can you include a short CSV that lists which artifacts are redacted (yes/no) and why? That helps our auditors.

We'll run the ingest on Mon 11/16 and invite Redwood to the validation call afterwards. Elena — cc'ing Procurement for visibility.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Skyward Insurance
